routes.note: Closed by 0153 and the #5706 ruling. A span over a field slot's current value has K5.6's posture when the slot is overwritten in the same body, through a call (`frame.Reset()`), or under a storage-bounded callback: drop-on-overwrite disposes and flags the viewed buffer, and the next span read faults with `DisposedAccessException` in the default checked build (undefined only in an explicitly unchecked build, like every stale member access). The v0.331 counterexample (`var s := _buf.AsSpan(); _buf := new OwningBuffer<int>(4); return s[0];`) now compiles and faults at the read. A slot kill by `move` (restored per #5695) leaves the buffer alive and unflagged, under the domain clause K5.6 names, as for the class-borrow twin. Not a new K4.3 clause, and no report line (§28.14 says so). The flag is the K4.1 backstop, so K4.3 clause 3 requires no recorded clause. The compiler does not yet check span reads (#5720), and checked mode is still opt-in there (#4602). Both are implementation gaps, not spec gaps.

routes.note: Closed by the #5693 ruling. The listed members (`ToArray`, `Sorted`, `Reversed`, `Slice`, range slicing, inline-array `ToArray`, `Array<T>(size, fill)`, `LinkedList<T>(source)`, value-T `OwningBuffer<T>(length, init)`, LINQ `ToArray`/`ToSet`/`ToDictionary`, `AddRange`, `UnionWith`, span `Fill`/`CopyFrom`/`CopyTo`), and any member meeting the generic definition, are judged at the call as a store of each placed value into the destination. A copied value carries its source's elements' sources (weakest source), a `fill`/`value` its own, and a selector or `init` result what invoking it carries. Verdict: admitted into a local destination its sources outlive, then under §28.11's collection-held clause for a later kill. Rejected into a field, a return or a wider or escaping collection: with no residual at a value element, under §28.11's residual at a class element. The v0.331 counterexample (`_keep := xs.ToArray();`) is now rejected. Hunted, none escaped: the members not in the list (`Stack`/`Queue` `ToArray`, a span view's indexer-set, `FrozenArray.From`, whose `T` is sendable and holds no borrow); lazy operators (frames, judged by carried sources); a result passed to an `owned` parameter (escapes the method). #5717 (open) asks the stdlib to mark each member at its declaration. Membership is already decided by §9.7's definition plus "among them", so #5717 does not open the cell.
